theme: custom-tuned (board.jpg measured in OKLCH; leaf green + poster orange locked as brand)
geometry: squared (--radius-sm:2px, --radius-md:6px, --radius-lg:12px) — flat + hairline, no soft cards/pills

macros.index: Catalogue — menu is the product, price docket in the fold, ruled inventory rows
macros.order: Narrative Workflow — 01 Plan → 02 Customize → 03 Checkout with numbered stage tracker
macros.login: Functional app — one measured card, no enrichment
macros.dashboard: Functional app — card stack, JS-rendered contract preserved (plan-card, meal-card, address-item, profile-grid, btn-tiny)
macros.payment-success: Letter — green check pinned above serif headline, letter body, ruled note, revealed actions
macros.privacy-policy: Long Document — one measure, hairline section rules, content preserved verbatim
macros.admin: Functional tool — token-compatible only, secret-gated, no shared nav/footer
macros.bot-messages: Functional tool — token-compatible only, secret-gated, no shared nav/footer

nav.implementation: .nav-wrap sticky wraps .nav-banner + .nav; banner collapses to max-height:0 under .nav-scrolled (passive scroll listener in nav.js, additive only)
nav.auth: unchanged — ff:auth sessionStorage cache, window.__ffAuth prefetch consumption, APG disclosure menu, logout, mobile burger

footer.implementation: footer-verse 'Yours, the FitFuel kitchen.' + wordmark-as-signature + tagline + minimal links + colophon '© 2026 Jadpod Fitness Private Limited' + Razorpay trust

section-numerals: sections carry editorial numerals (01— / 02— / 03—) on marketing page

diversification.rejected-priors: N6 masthead (failed gate), N1a nav + Ft1 footer (warm-consumer system, superseded by design.md)
diversification.stamps: main.css and nav.css carry genre/macro/system comments; design.md supersedes warm-consumer spec

constraints-honoured: plan titles render as-is from DB (emoji-prefixed), never split/renamed
'by Jadpod Fitness Pvt Ltd' in nav; '© 2026 Jadpod Fitness Private Limited' in footer
no Login button in nav when signed out
admin.html / bot-messages.html secret-gated, never load shared nav
